a100.measured_note: No measured A100 decode trace exists in the repo (results/DECISION.md:96 lists it Open). Public anchor, short context only: TensorRT-LLM Llama-3-8B ~4,500 output tok/s on one A100 40GB (Modal example, https://modal.com/docs/examples/trtllm_llama). The A100 rows below are a roofline with the repo's assumed efficiencies, i.e. an UPPER bound for the A100.

qwen_q4_inside_a100.basis: one 826 mm2 die, q4p25 weights in 596 mm2 ROM, 81 mm2 compute, NO KV term on either side (A100 by_batch goes compute-bound at 20,612 tok/s from b=64 with no KV read or capacity limit)

ds_array_vs_gpu.basis: DSV4-Flash (not V4.1), 50,530-68,460 mm2 analytical arrays, against a B200 cluster modelled as link-latency-bound tensor parallel (its own caveat), roofline both sides

wafer_vs_array.basis: array b4096 aggregate 113k-1.35M tok/s at 2-12 wafer-equivalents, analytical
